high_level_description: stc brand style, an aerial view of a large mission control room with rows of desks and giant wall screens displaying maps and network diagrams, lit in vivid red.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A large amphitheater-style control room lit dramatically in red, with curved rows of desks and monitors.

elements.desc: Rows of operators seated at curved desks facing forward.
Large wall-mounted screens displaying a world map with connection lines, a grid of network status indicators, and a node diagram.
